title: hypericum walteri
intro: Hypericum walteri, commonly known as St. Andrew's-cross, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hypericaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum walteri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as wound healing, pain relief, and anti-aging effects. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to exhibit sedative and antispasmodic properties, making it a valuable resource for natural remedies.
